label: Sernik
note: Polish cheesecake from twaróg (curd), eggs and butter, no cream or sour cream; dates to the 17th century; variants krakowski with lattice crust, królewski with cocoa crust, wiedeński crustless

about.text: Polish baked cheesecake made from twaróg curd cheese.
